integrity: The final claim is proved directly from the defining fundamental equation. The focal source is used as literature motivation and for the surrounding dilation conditions; no unverified displayed special-case formula is needed as a premise.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes the rank-one nilpotent tuple is already a Gamma_n-contraction and does not classify the spectral-set region in coefficient space.
The result classifies the fundamental-operator conditions themselves; it does not assert that they are necessary for the existence of a Gamma_n-isometric dilation.
The originality comparison cannot exclude an older equivalent formulation under different terminology.
title: Exact phase boundary for dilation conditions in rank-one nilpotent \(\Gamma_n\)-contractions
